properties.description: 调整类型（百分比或数量），用于自动调整计算。 【Swagger】This field defines the type of the adjustment (e.g. Percentage or Quantity). The chosen type determines how the AdjustmentValue is interpreted and applied for the auto-adjustment calculations.

properties.name: adjustmentValue
properties.description: 定义基于所选调整类型用于自动调整计算的值。 【Swagger】This field defines the value used for auto-adjustments calculations based on the chosen AdjustmentType.

properties.name: totalProcessTimeBulk
properties.description: 总加工时长（整批处理） 【Swagger】The total process time where containers/lots are processed in bulk. The entire lot is processed as one unit. There is no dependence on the process time for the qty of units in the lot/container. TPT Bulk based on Default Qty.

properties.name: totalProcessTimeUnit
properties.description: 总加工时长（按单位独立计） 【Swagger】The total process time where containers/lots are processed by units. Each unit is the lot is processed independently. The quantity of units in the lot impact the process time at a process step.

properties.name: rptMinimumValue
properties.description: 允许的最小RPT值，默认为1，用户可改为大于1.0的值。 【Swagger】This is the Minimum RPT value allowed. Default is set to 1. User can change as long as > 1.0.​
